agents.title: Give agents a starter they can extend safely.
agents.description: Each slice owns its UI, server rules, and data flow, so automated contributors can add features without destabilizing the rest.
runbook: Read the slice-local server actions and route guards first.
Add new product logic inside its own feature boundary.
Reuse auth, account, and email primitives instead of rebuilding them.
Leave unrelated slices untouched unless the contract really changes.
